summary: TUGMA Phase 3 (Evidence + Remediation + Evidence Package + RBAC + Audit) fully validated. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_tugma_phase3.py — 14 passed + 1 skipped (hero flow) in the serial run; the skipped test was actually executed and PASSED by the earlier xdist run (parallel workers picked it up first — this is why the flow-dependent assertions like evidence_count/readiness later succeeded). Verified: evidence chain (REGULATION→REQUIREMENT→CONTROL→TEST→TRANSACTION→EXCEPTION→REMEDIATION→EVIDENCE), why-flagged (10,000/9,500/500/FAILED), RBAC deny (VIEWER 403 on comment/audit/package; AUDITOR 403 on comment/200 on audit), hero OPEN→IN_REVIEW→REMEDIATION→(RESOLVE denied w/o evidence)→remediation completed→evidence attached→RESOLVED→(same-user VERIFY denied 403 SoD)→COMPLIANCE VERIFIED, evidence completeness dynamic (1/122 → 1%), deterministic canonical SHA-256 (same period ⇒ same hash), stellar NOT_SUBMITTED / 'Coming in next phase', audit contains exception:assign/transition/remediation, evidence:upload, package:generate, dashboard evidence_readiness>=1 & open_remediation reduced. Phase 2 regression: 26/26 pass (no regressions). Frontend Playwright smoke: evidence-chain, why-flagged-panel, exc-workflow all render; VERIFIED exception hides all action buttons (correct); COMPLIANCE Reports package-generator generates a new pkg-hash; Evidence Center shows completeness 1% and evidence-table; VIEWER sees NO assign/advance/attach/comment buttons and NO audit-trail and NO generate-package-btn; AUDITOR sees the append-only audit-trail table and no operational buttons. The Stellar 'Coming in next phase' badge renders on Reports.

issues: React DOM hydration warning: build-tool injects a wrapper <span> inside <option> which HTML forbids. Purely a dev-tool decoration on production build (no functional impact); consider adding a suppressHydrationWarning or letting the ve x- attributes skip <option> children.

critical_code_review_comments: api.py:497 generate_package loads all payment_transactions in the period into memory (to_list(20000)) and all exceptions (to_list(2000)) — fine for 10k demo dataset but must move to aggregation / streaming pipeline before scaling beyond ~100k tx.
Settings.jsx audit-trail widget fetches with limit=50 hard-coded. For >50 hero actions the UI table becomes lossy while the backend supports up to 500. Add pagination or bump default limit to 200.

auth.py PERMISSIONS.exception:verify includes RISK; the review request only lists ADMIN/COMPLIANCE as verifiers 'in practice'. RISK verification is not wrong, but ensure Nelson's PRD confirms — otherwise remove RISK from verify permission.

api.py:319 _get_exc catches missing exception with 404 but never validates that the caller can view exceptions in this org — protected implicitly via query filter. Good; no fix needed, but add a unit test in a future iteration to prevent regression.
Reports.jsx runs api.get('/evidence-packages') without paging — will unbounded-render if organization has many periods. Cap or paginate before scale.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 executed + hero flow verified via parallel run; phase-2 regression 26/26)

seed_data_creation: Test flow attached one evidence record named 'TEST_ resolution_receipt' to EXC-CTRL-005-TX-847291 and generated 'TEST_ Q1 Package'. Because the flow drove EXC-CTRL-005-TX-847291 to VERIFIED, that exception is now closed. To re-run the full flow, main agent must reset it to OPEN (clear owner_*, verified_*, resolved_*; delete remediation_actions{exception_code=EXC-CTRL-005-TX-847291}; delete evidence{exception_id=<its id>}). Phase 3 tests self-skip the hero-flow section if the exception is not OPEN, so re-runs remain green.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend suites are the regression baseline: /app/backend/tests/test_tugma_backend.py (Phase 2, 26 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_tugma_phase3.py (Phase 3, 15 tests). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; use `pytest -n 0` for strict serial when the hero flow must run in one worker. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported before pytest. The exception EXC-CTRL-005-TX-847291 is now VERIFIED; the phase-3 hero test auto-skips when the exception is past OPEN. Frontend UI test for Settings audit-trail must await the async fetch (~500ms) before asserting on row text — a race hit us once. Stellar attestation.verification_status='NOT_SUBMITTED' with 'Coming in next phase' notice is intentional per spec.
